disposition_reason: Fifteen vegetable species (9 samples each) from three Noakhali markets were analysed for lead, cadmium, chromium, iron and nickel by AAS; Table 1 gives mean ± deviation per species in mg/kg fresh weight.

study.design: Market survey of 15 vegetable species with health risk assessment
study.market: three local markets, Noakhali district, Bangladesh
study.method: Oven drying, HNO3/H2SO4 + H2O2 wet digestion; AAS (PerkinElmer novAA 900H), graphite furnace for Cr, Cd, Pb, Ni and flame for Fe
lod: not printed in main text (validation in Supplementary Tables 1-2, not available)

Supplementary Tables 1-4 (validation, LODs) not present with the PDF.
